title: Chapter 407 Suzaku White Tiger
content:
Chapter 407 Suzaku White Tiger

Gradually, he seemed to have hallucinations.

The pain in the body began to fade.

When he returned to his childhood, his sister was next to him to protect him.

There is no longer the oppression of the human race or the oppression of the same race around me, living in the mountains and fields, living freely and happily.

"Brother, can we be together all our lives?"

My sister stood in front of her, her eyebrows and eyes curled, and her face was filled with a happy smile.

But all of this is just an illusion after all.

"Sister, I'm sorry, I will definitely not let you suffer in the next life."

In this way, the White Tiger Demon completely closed his eyes.

laugh!

A harsh sword sounded from the border, shocking the sky.

Immediately afterwards, a chill began to come to his face, and everyone felt a strong sense of oppression that made them unable to move at all.

Which expert is this?

The man with golden crown turned his head hard and saw a beautiful and charming woman with black hair like a waterfall, holding a long sword in her hand, and wearing a blue skirt slowly walked towards the place.

The terrifying pressure bloomed from his body.

"This senior, I am,"

"Have you spoke?"

Lu Xue spoke coldly and with a casual sword, she chopped off one hand of the Golden Crown man.

The man with golden crown was trembling all over, but he never dared to say anything again.

This is even more true for everyone around, and they dare not breathe.

I didn't expect that there would be such people here.

Soon, under the attention of the audience, Lu Xue walked to the White Tiger Little Demon.

The White Tiger Demon seemed to have lost his breath at this moment, but Lu Xue could feel it. He was still breathing a sigh of relief, but it was already extremely weak.

"The bloodline of the Heavenly Demon is indeed powerful."

Lu Xue spread her palms out, and a jade bottle appeared out of thin air, inside it, containing a huge source of life.

As Lu Xue poured the jade bottle over, liquid emitting a rich fragrance poured onto the body of the White Tiger Demon. In just an instant, the little demon's injuries quickly recovered.

The little demon, who had half his foot stepped into the gate of hell, came to life miraculously.

This scene made everyone present stunned and dumbfounded.

At the same time, they also did not understand why this powerful human race wanted to help the monsters of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Lu Xue put her hand on the white tiger's body again, and suddenly, her breath fluctuated, and a pretty boy appeared in front of everyone again.

The boy's eyelids trembled slightly and he slowly opened his eyes.

"Am I dead?"

"not yet."

Lu Xue smiled.

Suddenly, the boy's eyes suddenly became sharp. Just as he was about to take action, a pressure from his bloodline suddenly made him unable to move.

Ao Qing on Lu Xue's shoulder looked up at the boy and chuckled, "This junior is really interesting."

"you!"

The boy stared at Ao Qing on Lu Xue's shoulders, shocked.

"Boy, let's relax, we just saved you."

Ao Qing spoke.

Upon hearing this, the boy also reacted that he was safe and sound now, and seemed to have been rescued.

But when he turned to look at the ground, his eyes fell into despair again.

I saw my sister lying peacefully on the ground, without any hope.

With a plop.

The boy knelt on the ground, was silent for a moment, and suddenly burst into tears.

He hates, hates his own incompetence, and hates the cruelty of the human race.

"Boy, your sister is still saved."

At this time, Ao Qing spoke again.

As soon as these words came out, the boy's crying came to an abrupt end. He turned his head and looked at Ao Qing, then knelt down at Ao Qing.

"Senior, for the sake of your and my tribe, I beg you to save my sister."

As he said that, the young man didn't care whether Ao Qing lied to him or not, and started kowtowing wildly.

Dongdongdongdongdongdong.

Soon, countless cracks were smashed by the boy on the ground.

While everyone was shocked by the young man's strong power, they couldn't help but be curious about the identities of Lu Xue and Ao Qing.

This girl was almost unable to turn the world back on her meridians.

But this man Yilong actually said that there is still a rescue, which makes them not scared.

"It's not impossible to save your sister, but you don't respect my little master."

Ao Qing chuckled.

The boy was stunned for a moment, and then he soon understood.

He kowtowed to Lu Xue again, "Thank you for your help for your life. Bai Xu will never forget it. From now on, I will be willing to work hard for you."

"As long as you can save my sister!"

When Lu Xue heard the boy's words, his smile became even worse. This guy is very smart.

Immediately, Lu Xue grabbed Xiao Yao and her sister, rose up from the ground, and turned into a rainbow.

"Wo Chao, you guys wait for me, old man!"

The old man Duanjian, who was watching the show in the distance, saw Lu Xue leaving without hesitation and hurriedly followed closely.

At this point, the border returned to peace again.

"Sir, do you want it,"

"roll!"

The man with his only left hand slapped his subordinates away. Then, he ordered everyone around him to say that nothing happened today, and then he hurriedly left.

Lu Xue knew at a glance that he couldn't afford to offend him, and he wouldn't be looking for trouble.

Today, I can only admit defeat.

"Senior, how do you save my sister?"

Deep in the mountains, next to a quiet pond, Lu Xue and others appeared.

Bai Xu looked anxious at this moment. He felt that the more time had been delayed, the more dangerous his sister's situation would be.

Lu Xue looked at Bai Xu's sister and asked, "What's your sister's name?"

"Bai Ling."

"How did you and your sister meet?"

Bai Xu is a white tiger, but his sister is a Suzaku.

Something is wrong.

I would never read it wrong. Bai Ling is indeed a Vermillion Bird, but something seems to have made some mistakes, which leads to Bai Ling not being able to show his abilities, and even his transformation is not perfect.

"Bai Xu, do you know what your sister is?"

Hearing this question, Bai Xu frowned slightly, "My sister is a firebird, how could I not know that she was adopted by me back then."

"Your sister is not a firebird, but a Suzaku."

"What's the matter?!"

Suzaku?

Bai Xu opened his mouth wide and stood there in a daze.

Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

"Get back to the point, the method to save your sister is very simple. The bloodline of the Heavenly Demon is the source of the bloodline of the demon clan. Just need the help of the pure Heavenly Demon bloodline, and your sister will be resurrected."

Upon hearing this, Bai Xu asked anxiously: "The bloodline of the Heavenly Demon is a legend. Where can I go to find the bloodline of the Heavenly Demon!"

Bai Xu didn't know that he had awakened the bloodline of the Heavenly Demon, but it was not very pure.

And at this time, Ao Qing stood up.

"Hmph, boy, the pure Sky Demon Bloodline owner, is standing in front of you now!"

Ao Qing, the pure bloodline of the Heavenly Demon, the uncrowned king of the Heavenly Demon Clan!

Bai Xu never expected that the senior of the same clan in front of him was so terrifying, and the bloodline of the Heavenly Demon Clan was so awesome.

"Senior, please!"

Bai Xu knelt on one knee to Ao Qing, looking pious.

Seeing this, Ao Qing no longer hesitated. He raised his dragon claws and cut a small hole in his body, and a drop of golden blood slowly flowed out.

Bai Xu carefully took the drop of Tianmo blood and then dripped it on Bai Ling's body.

In an instant, vitality burst out and golden light suddenly appeared.
